title: Accounting follow-through
description: Review missing documents and payment follow-ups against authoritative connected sources.

blocks.title: Needs attention
blocks.intent: List only source-backed accounting exceptions that need a human next action. Use a stable id and interactive fields. A missing claim requires an authoritative baseline and no credible match.

blocks.title: Unresolved gaps
blocks.intent: Count unresolved source-backed accounting exceptions. Do not count observations without an authoritative baseline.

blocks.title: Document coverage
blocks.intent: Report matched-document coverage only when an authoritative baseline provides a valid denominator; otherwise state unavailable.

blocks.title: Possible matches
blocks.intent: Show uncertain document-to-record matches with the baseline record, candidate document, and why human review is still needed.

blocks.title: Recently reconciled
blocks.intent: Show a concise receipt of accounting exceptions that were matched, corrected, dismissed, or materially changed.

blocks.title: Data boundary
blocks.intent: State which authoritative and evidence sources were available, what could not be verified, and the single safest next connection or action. Never imply that Screenpipe changed the books.
